title: Require Public Domain Surfaces In Tests
forbids: test files deep-importing domain internals instead of public contract or runtime router surfaces
why: Tests exercise domain contracts and implementations through the same named public contract and runtime router surfaces as product code. Test location alone does not grant private implementation access.
remediate: Replace each violating test import with a public domain surface only after the corresponding domain public surface exists. Do not widen a domain public surface merely to satisfy a test.
message: Use the domain root, runtime router, ops, artifacts, or named schema and policy owners instead of domain internals.
